ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Mshta.EXE Execution Patterns
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious mshta process execution patterns

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.htm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("mshta$")))))
